prompt: A single iconic logo artwork that fuses architecture, fine-art painting and building signage into one object. The mark is a simple house form with a gently pitched roof and one tall open doorway, soft rounded corners, calm and timeless proportions. Architecture: its outline is a precise, slim brushed-aluminium frame that traces the house like a clean architect's elevation line, with a faint etched drafting guideline extending past the roof apex. Painting: inside the frame sits a hand-painted panel of loose, confident oil brushwork with visible bristle texture and soft palette-knife edges, flowing from warm signal red at the lower left through blush pink to pale lilac at the upper right. Signage: the whole piece is a dimensional sign standing off a smooth board-formed pale concrete facade on hidden pins, gently backlit so a soft blush and lilac halo glows onto the concrete around it. Straight-on frontal view, perfectly centered, generous negative space of pale concrete around the mark, square composition. Soft diffused overcast daylight, palette strictly cloud white, pale concrete grey, graphite, signal red, blush and lilac. Hyperrealistic architectural photography, medium-format camera, ultra-detailed real materials, museum-quality craft, serene and premium, nothing sharp or aggressive. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark.
